map.生物碱（碱性）在 pH<4 成盐易溶、pH>9 游离沉淀；鞣质（如五倍子）遇碱性: Alkaloids (alkaline) form water-soluble salts below pH 4 and precipitate as free bases above pH 9; tannins (such as gallnut) readily complex and precipitate with alkaline constituents, so co-decocting them should be avoided.

map.生物碱碱性、苷类在酸/碱极端易水解或沉淀，配伍需看环境 pH。: Alkaloids are alkaline, while glycosides hydrolyze or precipitate at extreme acid or alkaline values, so the environmental pH must be considered in compatibility.
